output.reason: The linked PR [ev-c0c591455404] says it adds a new optional CLI flag, `--with-service-account`, to `flux create tenant`. Without the flag, the existing default (the tenant name) still applies. So the flag is `--with-service-account`, not `--service-account`, and the change is an addition, not a behaviour change. The release note [ev-7934fe792cbf] describes the same change.

correction.statement: Flux 2.7.0 adds an optional `--with-service-account` flag to `flux create tenant` that sets the name of the ServiceAccount the command creates; when the flag is not given, the default (the tenant name) is still used.
